notes.title: Scheduled Update & Bug Fixes on September 5th
notes.notes:
Regarding the Content of This Patch Update:
Note: After the update, a small number of old save files may become invalid due to bugs or other issues. Due to limitations in the engine mechanism, it is impossible to fully resolve this problem. If such an issue occurs, you can try loading one or two previous save files to continue progressing in the game. We apologize for any inconvenience caused!
BUG Fixes:Text-related Fixes
Corrected an error in the display of a character's name.

Fixed some typos.
Gameplay-related Fixes
Resolved the unexpected changes that occurred in the Chapter 1 maze when entering and exiting rooms.
Optimizations & Content Updates:
Optimized the text of certain dialogues to make the lines and content more logical.

Improved the performance of the chase sequence in Chapter 3.

Revamped the Prologue maze to a small extent: added an ice-skating puzzle that originally only appeared in the late stage of the Qi Line, and made the overall chase sequences easier.

Removed ambiguous branch paths in some mazes that could confuse players.

Updated and redrew some illustrations.




This update is a supplementary patch for Version 1.0.3. It fixes a prominent bug in Version 1.0.3 and integrates the previously optimized content into the official version. Therefore, except for this update, no further updates will be released temporarily in the near future unless there are critical bugs affecting gameplay that require a hotfix. All issues will be addressed collectively in the next update. The next update is still planned to be a major one, including features such as the Ending Collection Room and the Misu Collection Progress Bar, and will be released before the launch of the Side Story & Epilogue DLC.

notes.title: Update & Bug Fixes Scheduled for the Early Morning of September 1st
notes.notes:
Regarding the Content of This Patch Update:
Note: After the update, a small number of old save files may become invalid due to bugs or other issues. Due to limitations of the engine mechanism, it is impossible to fully resolve this problem. If such an issue occurs, you can try loading a save file from one or two steps back to continue the game. We apologize for any inconvenience caused!


DLC Changes:[olist]
Optimized and corrected the character standing images and walking sprites in the original art package.

Added split versions of some facial expressions for all in-game characters.

Added walking sprites for Nozomi Kurusu and Mao Shiina.
[/olist]Bug Fixes:Text-related Fixes[olist]
Fixed a timeline bug in the prologue.

Corrected a spelling error in the English text of a certain ending.

Fixed an issue where "Kion"’s name was displayed incorrectly at a specific point in the prologue.

Corrected some typos.
[/olist]Gameplay-related Fixes[olist]
Fixed a bug in Kino’s route: during the opening CG of the zombie minigame, zombies would move and attack the player while the game was paused under certain circumstances.

Fixed a bug where feeding Misu on the rooftop did not deduct dried fish normally, resulting in incorrect display of dried fish quantity afterward.

Fixed a bug in the chase sequence of Kino’s route that allowed the player to move outside the map boundaries.

Fixed a bug in Kine and Hanabi double puzzle minigame where monsters would directly attack Kion under specific conditions.

Fixed a critical error in Inori’s walking sprites.
[/olist]Optimizations and Content Updates:[olist]
Optimized the text of some dialogues to make the lines and content more logical and consistent.

Optimized and slightly adjusted content related to kyuka Shiomiya (such as kyuka”s terms of address for her parents) in the maze library of Chapter 3 in Kion’s route.

Slightly reduced the difficulty of dealing with the final monster in the library maze.

Added additional hints that appear in the early stages of the game.

Changed the positions of certain save points that previously caused the game to become unplayable after each version update.
[/olist]



In response to player suggestions and demands, we are currently working on developing an ending collection room and a Misu collection progress bar!




After this update, if there are no critical bugs affecting gameplay that require a hotfix, no further updates will be released in the near term. All issues will be addressed collectively in the next update. The next update is expected to be a major one, which will be released before the launch of the side story & epilogue DLC. Depending on the situation, some mazes may also be partially reworked.




Hua You would not have come this far without the love and support of every player. I will continue to pay close attention to all your feedback! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Expected update and BUG fix on March 4th
notes.notes:
Regarding the content of this update:
DLC changes:
1. Optimized the standing drawing of Hanabi in the original painting package (revised and launched on the afternoon of March 2nd).

Bug fix:
1. Fixed the lighting issue in Chapter 2's maze.
2. Fixed the issue in Chapter 2 where maze monsters were unable to pass through ghosts.
3. Fixed the issue of black screen when entering the toilet back and forth in Chapter 3 of Qixian.

Optimization and Content Update:
1. Optimized the operation prompt text for the prologue.
2. Optimized and modified the appearance location of Mi Su on the shrine map.
3. Optimized the visual effect of "Shuhua Decryption" in the true ending maze.
4. Added a new version of Xiyin's walking diagram.
5. Add a reminder before decrypting the maze in Chapter 2.
6. Before adding TE, players will be prompted to enter the true ending route.
7. Added the function of holding down Ctrl to fast forward text, while also retaining the function of holding down Enter to read text quickly.
8. Added an archive plugin, modified the archive interface, and the current version will take screenshots when archiving, displaying them in the file reading interface to avoid the problem of not being able to find the corresponding archive as much as possible.
9. Nowadays, the game no longer locks the movement keys. WASD and the up, down, left, and right directional keys can be used simultaneously, and the operation mode can be selected according to personal habits.


If there are any issues with your device in this version, you can try right clicking on "Hanabi and Ghost Girl" in the Steam library, selecting "Properties", "Beta", and "Participate in Testing" to roll back the version to Ver1.0.0

Note: Currently, no conflict free viewing history text plugin has been found, and the Steam overlay function also has some compatibility issues with RM. Therefore, solutions are still being researched, and once found, they will be updated in future versions. If any experienced experts see it, please make sure to contact me T T

notes.title: Final explanation on archiving issues and future update plans
notes.notes:
Firstly, regarding the issue of archiving.

The save issue from February 25th still exists, and we may not be able to recover save files that were not properly saved by the cloud save before that version update, or indirectly damaged as a result. These players will have to play the game again. We are launching Steam for the first time and have no experience with it. We are truly sorry, T.


Then, let's talk about future updates: 

In the future, we will slow down version updates to stabilize the version, and we have now found a way to integrate with Steam Cloud to prevent archive damage caused by version updates (except for archives with outdated versions).

 On Saturday, March 1st , the game will undergo an official version update of v1.0.0. After this update, the game should also be stable. In the future, unless there are serious bug issues, bugs will be fixed in batches on a regular basis, rather than releasing small version updates bit by bit.


Finally, I would like to express my gratitude to the players who have read this. Despite being a free game, I have put in my utmost effort to create and modify various bugs. Because my job is in art, I encountered an unexpected situation outside of the game engine in the Steam docking window for the first time, and I feel a bit overwhelmed. In addition to trying to fix it as much as possible, I can only hope that everyone can understand and tolerate it!

Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience and a happy life.

notes.title: Important update! February 25th Update&BUG Repair&Archive Issue Resolution
notes.notes:
Due to my lack of English proficiency, this announcement will be translated using machine translation. I apologize if there are any issues.

 This update announcement not only displays the updated content, but also focuses on addressing the issue of some players losing their saved files after the update! 
Since the release of the game, we have been continuously optimizing and updating, and have fixed many bugs. Nevertheless, due to my personal technical mistake, an unexpected situation occurred. After the bug was fixed and updated on February 22nd, many players' save files were lost and missing. I deeply apologize for the impact on everyone's enjoyable gaming experience!!! But because the subsequent versions were temporary and allowed players to enter the game, the underlying path issues were not fixed, which seriously hindered subsequent updates and version number comments. The expansion of the save limit column this time will also have a certain impact.
Therefore, we can only change the path again, which will result in some players (cloud save function often draws) losing their save again. We apologize again! In order to avoid affecting players who are currently playing, I chose to release this update in the early morning and try not to affect more people due to this issue.

 The following will provide a detailed explanation on how to recover your archive. The method is simple, and if you encounter this problem, please be sure to watch it: 
① Firstly, in your Steam game inventory list, find our game 'Hanabi and Ghost Girls'.
② Right click on the game - (point to) Manage - (click) Browse local files.
③ At this moment, the root directory of the game pops up, where you can see a folder called "花火与幽灵少女v0.9.82". Double click on this folder to open it.
④ The save folder here is your lost archive (don't worry about the other file)! Right click on the save folder and select copy.
⑤ Move back to the previous level, which is step 2, browse the game root directory after local files, and paste the save folder here.

In this way, you have successfully retrieved the lost save and can continue playing the game normally!!!
 We would also like to express our profound gratitude to the players who support and understand the difficulties of the Lone Wolf Maker. I hope this little incident won't affect your mood. 

 Regarding the content of this update: 
Bug fix:
1. Fixed the issue where the texture in the prologue caused players to pass through walls.
2. Fixed some text bugs and facial image display errors.
3. Fixed the issue of incorrect display of bubble expressions in Chapter 3 of Xiyin Line.

Optimization and Content Update:
1. Increase the manual save slots of the game from 19 to 40!
2. Optimized some of the chase battles and added or modified the location of save points before the chase battle, so that if the chase battle fails, there will be no need to watch long storylines again.
3. Optimized the display of the title interface when entering the game, now it will be faster than before.
4. Refine the option prompt for (this option will affect the game ending) to (this option will affect the favorability of a character, and when the favorability reaches a specific condition, it will change the game ending).
5. Optimized some CG performance effects.
6. Added some object interactions (mainly for the prologue and first chapter).

So far, that's all for this update. Thank you to the players for their feedback. I have carefully read and considered every comment, and I also ask everyone to continue supporting 'Hanabi and Ghost Girls'
